source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: As the first battle round begins, choose one enemy unit as this model's prey. Melee attacks against the prey by models in the same unit as this model may re-roll their **Wound rolls**. Whenever the prey is **destroyed**, pick another enemy unit as the new prey.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effect.attacks: melee attacks by models in this model's unit targeting its prey
